items.title: Do you have a favourite AI video model for dialogue?
items.summary:
Do you have a favourite AI video model for dialogue?

@LeonardoAi offers a wide range of video models, so I ran an identical text-to-video prompt in a few of them.

The dialogue was written with hard consonants and sibilants spread throughout, plus a deliberate pause to see how the models handle it.

The results, in order; Kling 3.0, Gemini Omni Flash, Seedance 2.0.

All three give strong results and I'm interested how each model interprets the prompt, handles the dialogue/lip sync, and manages facial expressions and subtle body and hand movements. 

Which version do you prefer?
